title: New mRNA Vaccine Offers Hope in Fight Against Skin Cancer
subtitle: Recent clinical trial results show promise for a personalized treatment for high-risk melanoma patients.

summary.en: Pharmaceutical companies Moderna and Merck have reported positive results from a major clinical trial for a new skin cancer vaccine. The treatment uses mRNA technology to create a personalized approach for patients with high-risk melanoma. By training the immune system to recognize specific cancer mutations, the vaccine aims to prevent the disease from returning. Experts believe this development represents a significant step forward in cancer research. Further studies will continue to evaluate the long-term effectiveness of this new medical tool.
summary.zh: 製藥公司莫德納與默克宣布，一項針對新型皮膚癌疫苗的大型臨床試驗取得了正面結果。該療法利用 mRNA 技術，為高風險黑色素瘤患者提供個人化的治療方案。透過訓練免疫系統辨識特定的癌症突變，該疫苗旨在預防疾病復發。專家認為此項發展代表癌症研究向前邁進了一大步。後續研究將持續評估此項新醫療工具的長期有效性。

paragraphs.en: A major breakthrough in medical science is bringing new hope to patients fighting skin cancer. Pharmaceutical companies Moderna and Merck recently announced successful results from a large-scale clinical trial for a new vaccine designed to treat melanoma. Melanoma is a serious and dangerous form of skin cancer that can spread quickly if not treated effectively. This new development uses mRNA technology, which is the same type of science used to create some of the most effective vaccines for COVID-19.
paragraphs.zh: 醫學界的一項重大突破，為對抗皮膚癌的患者帶來了新希望。製藥公司莫德納 (Moderna) 與默克 (Merck) 近期宣布，一項針對治療黑色素瘤所研發的新型疫苗，在大型臨床試驗中取得了成功。黑色素瘤是一種嚴重且危險的皮膚癌，若未經有效治療，癌細胞可能會迅速擴散。這項新進展採用了信使核糖核酸 (mRNA) 技術，這與研發部分最有效的 COVID-19 疫苗所使用的科學原理相同。

paragraphs.en: According to reports on the latest trial, the vaccine is personalized for each individual patient. This means the medicine is created specifically to target the unique genetic changes found in a person’s own cancer cells. By training the immune system to recognize these specific mutations, the vaccine helps the body find and destroy cancer cells that might remain after surgery. This approach is designed to stop the cancer from coming back, which is a major concern for patients who have already undergone treatment.
paragraphs.zh: 根據最新試驗的報告，該疫苗是為每位患者量身打造的。這意味著藥物是專門針對個人癌細胞中獨特的基因變化而設計。透過訓練免疫系統辨識這些特定的突變，疫苗能協助人體找出並摧毀手術後可能殘留的癌細胞。這種方法旨在防止癌症復發，而這正是許多已接受治療的患者最擔憂的問題。

paragraphs.en: Céline Gounder, an editor-at-large for public health at KFF Health News, recently discussed the potential of this breakthrough on CBS News 24/7. Drawing on her own experience as a former melanoma patient, Gounder highlighted why this innovation is so important for the medical community. The trial results suggest that this personalized vaccine could change the way doctors handle high-risk cases, providing a new layer of protection that was not available before.
paragraphs.zh: 凱撒家庭基金會健康新聞 (KFF Health News) 的公共衛生特約編輯席琳·岡德 (Céline Gounder)，近期在哥倫比亞廣播公司新聞台 (CBS News 24/7) 討論了這項突破的潛力。岡德以自身曾是黑色素瘤患者的經驗為例，強調了這項創新對醫學界的重要性。試驗結果顯示，這種個人化疫苗可能會改變醫師處理高風險病例的方式，提供過去所沒有的額外保護層。

paragraphs.en: While the results are very positive, experts note that this is still a developing area of medicine. A clinical trial is a research study conducted with human participants to see if a new medical treatment is safe and effective. The success of this Phase 3 trial—the final and most important stage of testing before a drug can be approved for general use—is a significant milestone. However, researchers will continue to monitor the participants to understand how long the protection lasts and how the vaccine performs in different groups of people.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管結果非常正面，專家指出這仍是醫學發展中的領域。臨床試驗是一項以人類參與者為對象的研究，旨在確認新的醫療方式是否安全有效。第三期試驗是藥物獲准廣泛使用前，最後且最重要的測試階段，此次試驗的成功是一個重要的里程碑。然而，研究人員將持續追蹤參與者，以了解保護效果能維持多久，以及疫苗在不同族群中的表現。

paragraphs.en: This news follows a series of recent updates regarding medical innovations and healthcare access. As researchers continue to refine mRNA technology, the focus remains on how these tools can be used to treat other types of diseases in the future. The ability to create a treatment that is custom-made for a patient’s specific biology is a major goal for modern medicine. If the vaccine continues to show success in the coming months, it could eventually become a standard part of care for those at high risk of melanoma.
paragraphs.zh: 這則消息緊接在近期一系列關於醫療創新與醫療照護普及的更新之後。隨著研究人員持續精進 mRNA 技術，焦點仍放在未來如何運用這些工具來治療其他類型的疾病。創造出能針對患者特定生物特徵量身打造的治療方式，是現代醫學的主要目標。若該疫苗在未來幾個月持續展現成效，最終可能成為高風險黑色素瘤患者的標準照護流程之一。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the science of the vaccine itself, the broader healthcare industry is also looking at ways to improve patient outcomes through various tools and systems. For example, KFF Health News has reported on how hospitals are using simple tools like wristbands to help reduce risks during childbirth, and how patients can save money by shopping around for the best prices on surgery. These efforts, combined with the new cancer vaccine, show a clear trend toward using technology and better information to improve health and save lives.
paragraphs.zh: 除了疫苗本身的科學技術外，更廣泛的醫療產業也正透過各種工具與系統，尋求改善患者治療成果的方法。例如，凱撒家庭基金會健康新聞曾報導醫院如何利用腕帶等簡單工具來降低分娩過程中的風險，以及患者如何透過貨比三家來節省手術費用。這些努力結合新型癌症疫苗，顯示出利用科技與更完善的資訊來改善健康並拯救生命的明確趨勢。

paragraphs.en: As we look ahead, the medical community will be watching closely for the next steps from Moderna and Merck. The process of bringing a new vaccine to the public involves many steps, including reviews by government health agencies to ensure the treatment is safe for everyone. For now, the successful trial results offer a bright spot for patients and families who have been waiting for new ways to fight this difficult disease. While there is still more work to be done, the progress made so far marks a hopeful chapter in the history of cancer treatment.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，醫學界將密切關注莫德納與默克的後續行動。將新疫苗推向大眾的過程涉及許多步驟，包括由政府衛生機構進行審查，以確保治療對所有人皆安全。目前，成功的試驗結果為等待對抗這種棘手疾病新方法的患者與家屬，帶來了一線曙光。雖然仍有許多工作要做，但迄今為止的進展，標誌著癌症治療史上充滿希望的一章。

quiz.question: What is the primary function of the new melanoma vaccine according to the second paragraph?

options.A: It replaces the need for surgical removal of cancer cells.
options.B: It helps the immune system identify and eliminate remaining cancer cells after surgery.
options.C: It prevents the initial development of skin cancer in healthy individuals.
options.D: It changes the genetic makeup of a patient to make them immune to melanoma.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第二段明確指出，這種疫苗的作用是「訓練免疫系統識別特定的突變，幫助身體在手術後找到並消滅可能殘留的癌細胞」。選項 A 錯誤，因為疫苗是輔助手術後的治療，而非取代手術；選項 C 錯誤，文中提到這是針對已患病者；選項 D 錯誤，疫苗是針對癌細胞的突變，而非改變患者自身的基因。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why is the 'personalized' aspect of this vaccine considered a significant advancement?

options.A: It allows the vaccine to be manufactured much faster than traditional vaccines.
options.B: It ensures that the vaccine is effective regardless of the patient's age.
options.C: It addresses the specific biological variations of a patient's cancer, increasing treatment precision.
options.D: It eliminates the need for any further medical monitoring after the initial injection.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第二段，疫苗是為每個患者量身打造的，旨在針對該患者癌細胞中獨特的基因變化。由此可推論，這種「個人化」的設計能提升精準度，因為它直接攻擊該患者體內的特定病灶。選項 A 文中未提及速度優勢；選項 B 文中未提及年齡因素；選項 D 與第四段提到的「研究人員將繼續監控參與者」相矛盾。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'milestone' mean in the context of the Phase 3 trial's success?

options.A: A physical marker used to measure distance.
options.B: A significant event or stage in a process of development.
options.C: A mandatory requirement for all pharmaceutical companies.
options.D: A final failure that stops further research.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在文中，「milestone」指的是在研究過程中達到的一個重要階段或里程碑。這是一個比喻用法，代表該試驗的成功是醫學進展上的重大成就。選項 A 是該詞的字面意思，在此處不適用；選項 C 指的是必要條件，但里程碑強調的是進展而非義務；選項 D 與文中對試驗成功的正面描述完全相反。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding the new melanoma vaccine?

options.A: The vaccine is already available for all patients to purchase at local pharmacies.
options.B: mRNA technology is exclusively used for treating skin cancer and no other diseases.
options.C: The new vaccine represents a promising, personalized medical advancement, though further research is required.
options.D: Government health agencies have already fully approved the vaccine for general public use.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文的核心在於介紹這種運用 mRNA 技術的個人化疫苗，強調其在對抗黑色素瘤方面的潛力，同時在第四段和第七段提醒讀者，這仍是一個發展中的領域，還需要更多研究與政府監管流程。選項 A 與 D 錯誤，因為文中提到還需經過審查；選項 B 錯誤，文中第五段提到未來目標是將此技術應用於其他疾病。
